The graph shows how the displacement of the particles in a medium varies with distance when a longitudinal wave is travelling through the medium. A positive displacement on the graph represents displacement to the right. The displacement at is shown by the solid line and the displacement at ms is shown by the dashed line. The time period of the wave is . ms.

a. Outline what is meant by a longitudinal travelling wave.
